review_candidates.description: About The Company HENSOLDT is a leading European high-tech company specializing in defense and security industries, headquartered in Taufkirchen near Munich. The company focuses on developing advanced sensor solutions, electronics, and software across various domains including air, land, sea, cyber, and space. With a mission to support armed forces worldwide in early threat detection and informed operational decision-making, HENSOLDT leverages decades of experience in mission-critical sensor technology. The company's expertise encompasses radar, optronics, electronics, and cyber capabilities, which are integrated with data-driven software and artificial intelligence to deliver innovative solutions. In the fiscal year 2025, HENSOLDT achieved a revenue of 2.46 billion euros, employing approximately 9,500 professionals. The company is publicly traded on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange within the MDAX index. About The Role We are seeking a talented Software Developer to join our Software & Hardware Framework division at our Oberkochen location. This role involves designing and developing a cross-sectional software framework that underpins all future products. The framework includes operating systems, communication protocols, cross-cutting applications, and more. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development with a focus on Rust programming language, contributing to the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of high-performance, secure, and reliable software components. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to create innovative solutions, participate in agile development processes, and ensure the seamless integration of the framework into our product ecosystem. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge defense technology, impacting global security and defense systems. Qualifications The successful candidate should possess a university degree in computer science or a related field with a focus on software development. Proven, practical experience in Rust programming is essential, along with a desire to deepen expertise as a Rust specialist within the team. Familiarity with network protocols and interfaces such as TCP/UDP, QUIC, HTTP(S), WebSockets, MQTT, serialization, and TLS is required. Additional knowledge in areas like C++, TypeScript (for frontend/backend API design and Node.js/Deno environments), or web development (preferably Svelte) is advantageous. Proficiency in Git, build pipelines, unit testing, and test automation is necessary. Experience with embedded Linux development (AArch64), containerization, and related technologies is a plus. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and interconnected thinking skills, a proactive work ethic, and excellent social skills to work effectively within a team. Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken, is mandatory. Responsibilities Your primary responsibilities will include conceptualizing, developing, and maintaining a cross-cutting software framework primarily in Rust. You will contribute to software architecture by creating technical designs and concepts, with a focus on secure and high-performance Rust implementations. Developing robust, memory-safe software components under Linux will be a key task, ensuring reliability and efficiency. You will establish and maintain Rust build and release pipelines using tools such as Cargo and crates.io, alongside leveraging modern software technologies like Git, Atlassian tools, and containerization. Implementing asynchronous and concurrent software solutions with Tokio will be part of your role. Conducting code reviews aligned with Rust best practices—covering ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, and error handling—is essential. Additionally, you will participate in agile planning and execution processes, primarily using SCRUM methodology, to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software modules. Benefits At HENSOLDT, we value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to foster work-life balance and personal growth. Employees enjoy flexible working hours and a supportive work environment that promotes health and well-being. Our compensation and social benefits are competitive within the industry, including opportunities for professional development and career advancement. We emphasize a positive workplace atmosphere, health and wellness programs, mobility support, and sustainability initiatives. We believe in empowering our team members to thrive both professionally and personally, providing resources and support for continuous learning and innovation. Equal Opportunity HENSOLDT is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of origin, age, gender, disability, gender identity, or worldview. Our company values the unique perspectives and experiences each employee brings, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and contribute meaningfully. We believe that diversity enhances our innovation and competitiveness, and we are dedicated to equal opportunity employment practices.

review_candidates.title: Full stack Developer
review_candidates.description: About The Company TRUMPF is a family-run, high-tech enterprise renowned for its innovative solutions across multiple technological domains. With nearly 19,000 employees at 71 locations worldwide, TRUMPF is committed to pushing the boundaries of technology to create the unimaginable. The company's core areas include lasers, machine tools, EUV technology, and electronics, all aimed at building technological worlds for future generations. The company culture emphasizes collaboration, mutual trust, and a willingness to challenge the status quo, fostering an environment where unconventional ideas and forward thinking are highly valued. TRUMPF’s dedication to innovation and excellence positions it as a leader in the high-tech industry, continuously inspiring people to develop groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. About The Role We are seeking a talented Embedded Linux Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, integrating, and optimizing comprehensive software solutions spanning embedded applications, device drivers, backend services, APIs, frontends, human-machine interfaces (HMIs), and diagnostic interfaces. Your expertise will contribute to building robust and efficient systems that meet the high standards of TRUMPF’s innovative environment. You will work on designing build, deployment, update, and configuration processes for Yocto- and Debian-based Linux platforms, ensuring smooth operation and continuous improvement. Additionally, you will develop and optimize image processing algorithms, build test and analysis tools, and maintain diagnostic and configuration utilities. Your role will also involve analyzing system errors during field testing and commissioning, troubleshooting issues related to hardware, software, and sensors, and implementing technical solutions directly on the system. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies in a collaborative and innovative setting. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or technical computer science, or have comparable qualifications with practical experience in developing integrated software systems. Strong proficiency in Linux and embedded Linux environments, especially with Yocto and Debian, is essential. You should have hands-on experience with build, deployment, and configuration processes, along with the ability to develop or integrate applications and device or interface drivers on Linux-based systems using C/C++. Additional scripting skills, particularly in Python, are advantageous. A solid understanding of hardware-near software, sensor technology, and complex system interactions is required. Candidates should demonstrate a structured, independent work style, practical problem-solving skills, and enthusiasm for rapid prototyping. Proficiency in German at level C1 is necessary to communicate effectively within the team. Knowledge of image processing is desirable, but a willingness to learn this field is acceptable. Good command of English is also beneficial for collaboration in our international environment. Responsibilities Develop, integrate, and optimize embedded Linux applications, device drivers, backend services, APIs, HMIs, and diagnostic interfaces to deliver comprehensive software solutions. Design and enhance build, deployment, update, and configuration processes for Yocto- and Debian-based Linux platforms to ensure system stability and efficiency. Create, test, and optimize image processing algorithms, building suitable tools for testing and analysis to support system performance improvements. Develop and maintain auxiliary tools for diagnostics, configuration, and system commissioning, while considering existing tool landscapes and integrating database connections where necessary. Participate in system testing and onsite commissioning, analyzing and troubleshooting issues related to software, hardware, and sensor interactions, and implementing technical solutions directly on the system. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware and software components, contributing to the continuous improvement of system functionalities. Document technical specifications, procedures, and troubleshooting guides to facilitate team knowledge sharing and future development efforts. Benefits TRUMPF offers a supportive and inclusive work environment within a family-owned company that values diversity and equal opportunities. Employees benefit from an innovative workplace equipped with state-of-the-art technology that fosters creativity and efficiency. The company provides flexible working hours and options for remote work, enabling a healthy work-life balance. A comprehensive training and development program is available to support your career growth and skill enhancement. Employees enjoy daily freshly prepared, healthy meals at discounted prices, available in the company restaurant or for takeaway. Additional benefits include competitive compensation packages, health and wellness programs, and opportunities for international collaboration. TRUMPF’s commitment to employee well-being and professional development makes it an ideal place to grow your career in the high-tech industry. Equal Opportunity TRUMPF is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and fairness. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, or other personal characteristics. Our goal is to foster a culture of mutual respect and collaboration, ensuring that every team member has the opportunity to succeed and contribute to our shared vision of technological innovation.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Chainlink Runtime
review_candidates.description: About Chainlink Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link. About The Role The Senior Software Engineer will play a critical role in advancing the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of the Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE) platform. Working on foundational platform capabilities, this role will design and build distributed systems that enable resilient workflow execution while supporting the continued growth of one of Chainlink's flagship products. Your Impact Design, build, and operate highly scalable platform services that improve the reliability and performance of the CRE platform. Lead the development of production-grade backend services and APIs that support multiple internal stakeholders and platform consumers. Drive architectural improvements that enable both vertical and horizontal platform scaling. Improve workflow execution durability and platform resilience through thoughtful engineering, rigorous testing, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams across the organization to deliver cross-functional platform initiatives from architectural design through production deployment. Strengthen platform ownership by reducing operational silos, improving documentation, and increasing shared knowledge across the engineering organization. Contribute to improving platform reliability through engineering practices aligned with service reliability objectives and measurable operational outcomes. Required Skills Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale production platforms. Advanced proficiency developing production systems in Go (Golang). Experience building production APIs and backend applications serving multiple stakeholders. Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems. Demonstrated ability to deliver reliable, high-quality software through rigorous engineering practices. Strong systems thinking with the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs and solve complex technical problems. Self-driven approach with a high degree of ownership, technical curiosity, and continuous learning. Excellent collaboration and communication skills within cross-functional engineering environments. Preferred Skills Experience defining, measuring, and improving service reliability through SLOs and SLIs. Experience developing software using TypeScript, Solidity, or additional backend technologies. Strong interest in blockchain infrastructure and Web3 technologies. Experience building decentralized applications (dApps). Experience developing financial infrastructure, banking systems, or other mission-critical distributed platforms. All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST). We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes. The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to our Recruiting Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required.
